title: Putnam-Fuglede commutativity and the range-kernel orthogonality of an elementary operator
summary: Given Hilbert space commuting operators $T, S \in \mcl(H)$, such that $T$ is $w$-hyponormal with $\ker T \subseteq \ker T^*$ and $S$ is normal operator. Let $φ_{T, S} \in \mcl(\mcl(H))$ be the elementary operator defined by $φ_{T, S} (X) = T X S^*-S X T^*$. In this paper, we show firstly that (1) $\ker φ_{T, S} \subset \ker φ_{T^*, S^*}$. (2) The range of $φ_{T, S}$ is orthogonal to the kernel of $φ_{T, S}$ ( $ \mcr(φ_{T, S}) \perp \ker φ_{T, S} $ ) if and only if $\ker T \cap \ker S=\{0\}$.
